- Handle base cases n in {0,1} -> 0, n == 2 -> 1; validate n is non-negative integer and possibly raise ValueError for negatives.
- Use iterative DP with O(1) space: maintain a, b, c for fibfib(n-3), fibfib(n-2), fibfib(n-1) initialized to 0, 0, 1; loop from 3..n computing next = a + b + c, then shift (a, b, c) <- (b, c, next).
- Return c for n >= 2; ensure efficiency for large n (linear time, constant space); consider using Python’s big integers naturally without overflow.
